identity.title: TUBELEX English regex ASCII word-frequency profile

construct.unit: lowercase NFKC-normalized ASCII alphabetic surface token
construct.population_or_exposure_claim: frequency evidence from the sampled English YouTube subtitle corpus, used only as an audiovisual/spoken-exposure approximation

language_varieties: multiple English varieties and non-native speech are present
corpus_design.sampling_frame: videos discovered by searches for Wikipedia article titles; 120,000 English videos sampled before cleaning
corpus_design.balancing_or_weighting: no project reweighting; source aggregate counts

processing.source_tokenization: TUBELEX regex orthographic words (Unicode word characters excluding digits), lowercased and NFKC-normalized
processing.input_tokenizer_mapping: NFKC-normalize input, then recognize whole ASCII alphabetic tokens; apostrophes and hyphens are boundaries
processing.normalization: Unicode NFKC followed by ASCII lowercase
processing.mwe_matching_policy: not applicable; component counts never become MWE counts

table.format: JSON; compact array rows nested in this manifest
table.total_row_rule: source [TOTAL] is located by label, validated, and excluded from rows

measurement.numerator_definition: profile-tokenized input tokens whose normalized form occurs in rows
measurement.denominator_definition: all profile-tokenized input tokens in the declared text
measurement.frequency_or_rank_formula: count / 179139158 * 1000000; competition rank by descending count
measurement.rank_tie_policy: equal counts share the first rank occupied by the tie; alphabetical order only stabilizes serialization
measurement.missing_item_policy: retain as unmatched with no invented zero frequency
measurement.zero_denominator_policy: value is null; preserve numerator and denominator

rights.required_attribution: TUBELEX, copyright 2022-4 Adam Nohejl; cite Nohejl et al. (2025)

validation.browser_size_or_latency_evidence: Node 24.9.0 arm64 smoke check on 2026-09-01: 6,157,414 bytes, JSON parse 71.0 ms, Map build 43.0 ms, about 72.5 MB heap after load; real-browser latency remains a release-gate test
validation.removal_or_replacement_procedure: delete this profile, its fetch/use/tests and TUBELEX notice; retain old releases for reproducibility where lawful
